bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are managing injury concerns ahead of their season opener in Carolina, as D'Andre Swift's injury update turned out more encouraging than it first appeared after he exited Thursday's practice, with ESPN's Adam Schefter reporting the issue was cramps. Meanwhile, the coaching staff is preparing the roster for Week 1, as defensive coordinator Dennis Allen expressed faith in the Bears' revamped defensive line with the season opener in Carolina looming a week from Sunday.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions saw running back Jahmyr Gibbs headline a group of six Detroit Lions voted into the 2026 NFL Top 100 , while the team also works through roster business ahead of the season opener. packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers are dealing with a major situation involving star running back Josh Jacobs, who is in hot water after being charged with battery and criminal destruction of property, leading the NFL to place him on the commissioner's exempt list , with his initial court appearance moved up to Sept. 10 .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings finalized their 53-man roster ahead of the 2026 season opener, with Kevin O'Connell's team gearing up to face the rival Green Bay Packers on September 13 in a Week 1 showdown. With the initial reveal of their final 53-man roster for the 2026 season, the Minnesota Vikings shared the decision to keep QB Max Brosmer.
